name: proxy-own-browser
description: Windows multi-profile browser with isolated persistent sessions and per-profile proxy settings.
author: mdnasiman641-cpu

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build:win: npm run check && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
